name: skill_ingest
description:
Ingest a methodology into the global skill catalog. Skills are shared across all sessions and tenants' queries.

CALL WHEN: You encounter or refine a reusable methodology — TDD, STRIDE threat modeling, debugging process, refactoring pattern, etc.

The server generates the version (YYYYMMDDNN) — do not pass it. Pass content_hash for idempotent re-ingest; re-running with an unchanged hash is a no-op.

Skills are stored with entity_type='skill', scope='global'. Category and additional tags become tag entities + TAGGED_AS edges. Prerequisites become REQUIRES edges. If a prerequisite skill doesn't exist yet, its name is recorded in `missing_prerequisites` on the response — the skill itself still lands. Either ingest the missing prereqs and re-run this skill, or accept the partial graph.

TAG NORMALIZATION: category and tags are normalized to lowercase, alphanumeric + dash only. Any other character (including underscore, space, slash) becomes `-`; consecutive dashes collapse and leading/trailing dashes are stripped. Example: 'Chaos Engineering' → 'chaos-engineering', 'unit_testing' → 'unit-testing', 'foo/bar/baz' → 'foo-bar-baz'. Use the same normalized form when calling retrieve_skills_for_context or ensure_parent_tag.

LEARN AND REFINE: If you use a skill and discover a better step, a missing prerequisite, or a clearer description, call ingest_skill again to refine it. Your changes persist across all sessions.
Cost: ~20ms + one embed call for description.

category.description: Primary tag (e.g., 'testing', 'security'). Becomes a tag entity + TAGGED_AS edge.

completion_criteria.description: How to tell when the skill's work is done.

content_hash.description: Caller-computed content hash for idempotent re-ingest. Passing the same hash as the stored skill is a no-op.

description.description: 2-4 sentence description of what the skill does and when to use it. Embedded for retrieval.

prerequisites.description: Names of other skills this requires.

session_id.description: Caller's session UUID (optional, recorded for audit). Omit or pass 'default' to use the configured default session.

steps.description: Ordered steps to follow when invoking the skill.

trigger_keywords.description: Keywords that indicate this skill is relevant.

duration_ms.description: Server-side tool execution duration in milliseconds.

requested_tool.description: Tool name requested by the client, after alias resolution.

tool.description: Canonical tool name that handled the call.

name: skills
description:
Find methodologies relevant to your current task from the global skill catalog.

CALL AT TASK START or whenever you encounter a problem you've solved before — 'how do I test this?', 'how should I refactor this?', 'what's the threat model here?'

Returns ranked skills with description, category, version, and a used_in_session flag. Match scoring combines description-embedding similarity, trigger_keyword overlap, tag overlap, and name hits.

These skills are GLOBAL — shared across every session. If a result is marked used_in_session=true, you've already touched it this session, which is a strong relevance signal.
Cost: O(catalog size) — typically <20ms for 100s of skills.

context.description: Current task context — what you're working on, the problem statement, or a natural-language question.

embedding.description: Optional context embedding. When present, enables semantic matching against skill description_embeddings.

session_id.description: Caller's session UUID (optional, used for the used_in_session flag).

duration_ms.description: Server-side tool execution duration in milliseconds.

requested_tool.description: Tool name requested by the client, after alias resolution.

tool.description: Canonical tool name that handled the call.

name: skill
description:
Fetch the structured steps for a named skill. Returns {description, steps, first_step_prompt, completion_criteria, output_artifacts}.

CALL WHEN: You've decided to apply a skill by name (e.g., after retrieve_skills_for_context returned it, or the user explicitly asked 'use TDD').

The response is pure data. Execute the steps yourself — invoke_skill does not orchestrate tool calls. Start with first_step_prompt. Check completion_criteria when you finish.

Missed skill returns INVALID_PARAMS with a did_you_mean list of similar skill names (phonetic match). Ingest the skill with ingest_skill if it genuinely doesn't exist yet.
Cost: ~5ms.

current_context.description: Optional context hint — what you're working on right now.

session_id.description: Caller's session UUID (optional; used for prerequisite-satisfaction tracking).

skill_name.description: Exact name of the skill to invoke (case-sensitive).

duration_ms.description: Server-side tool execution duration in milliseconds.

requested_tool.description: Tool name requested by the client, after alias resolution.

tool.description: Canonical tool name that handled the call.

name: tag_parent
description:
Idempotently create a PARENT_TAG edge between two tags in the global taxonomy, resolving tags by name (creating them if missing).

CALL WHEN: Building or extending the tag hierarchy — e.g. declaring that 'tdd' is a sub-category of 'testing', or that 'testing' is a sub-category of 'quality'. forge's fmem-skill-ingest uses this when ingesting `tag-hierarchy.yaml`.

TAG NORMALIZATION: names are normalized to lowercase, alphanumeric + dash only. Any other character (underscore, space, slash, etc.) becomes `-`; consecutive dashes collapse, leading/trailing dashes strip. 'Chaos Engineering' → 'chaos-engineering', 'unit_testing' → 'unit-testing'. Pre-normalize on the caller side if you want full control; otherwise the server's normalization is deterministic.

Returns action=Created on first call, action=Skipped on subsequent identical calls. Cycles are rejected via the graph client's DAG check.
Cost: ~5ms for idempotent re-runs, ~20ms when creating both tags + edge.

session_id.description: Caller session UUID (optional; used for ingested_by_session audit).

duration_ms.description: Server-side tool execution duration in milliseconds.

requested_tool.description: Tool name requested by the client, after alias resolution.

tool.description: Canonical tool name that handled the call.

name: skill_verify
description:
Verify a skill's graph neighborhood for ingest pipelines and audits. Returns resolved tags, prerequisites (outgoing REQUIRES), required_by (incoming REQUIRES), and missing_prerequisites (raw names declared at ingest that never landed as edges).

CALL WHEN: A bulk ingest finishes and the caller wants to confirm every skill's edges are intact. Safe to call for unknown skill names — returns {exists: false} cleanly, not an error.

This is an administrative read. For executing a skill, use invoke_skill.
Cost: ~10ms (one entity lookup + two edge scans).

duration_ms.description: Server-side tool execution duration in milliseconds.

requested_tool.description: Tool name requested by the client, after alias resolution.

tool.description: Canonical tool name that handled the call.
